title: Kospet Hope 4g smartwatch does not upload data to Nightscout
symptom: The Kospet Hope 4g smartwatch with Android 7.1 refuses to upload any data to Azure (Nightscout) despite receiving Bluetooth data from the transmitter (Blukon). Battery options and app permissions were checked. Setting the watch as a follower also shows nothing.
fix: The problem was solved by switching to Heroku for Nightscout hosting.
evidence_quote: At heroku it does upload so problem Solved!!!!!
